definitions.scope: Input metadata union for the configured models; includes frozen and explicitly supplied official records. One index/CSV row per matchid-game; absent replays remain explicit.
definitions.results: Official winner and final metadata scores. No confidence interval or causal strength claim.
definitions.family_head_to_head: One unique game, two appearances in per-model summaries; never add these as independent games.
definitions.source: Actual replay parent directory or official replay endpoint selected by study; aliases are not extra games.
definitions.stages: Observed state snapshots only. Missing/early-ended games are not padded. final mixes actual terminal steps, reported via mean_step.
definitions.scores_vs_cash: Final metadata score can differ from final observation cash; stage cash gap is not silently replaced by official margin.
